subject: Discovery action plan — roles, procurement milestones, and champion arming
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Diaz <m.diaz@novarisk.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novarisk.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery action plan — roles, procurement milestones, and champion arming

Hi Marco / Elena —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on decision criteria and the internal playbook you asked for: 

1) Decision roles we heard today
   - Marco Diaz — Technical champion (integration lead, owns pilot success)
   - Elena Rossi — Head of Data & AI (economic buyer / final approver)
   - Procurement (procurement@novarisk.com) — commercial/PO gate
   - Tom Alvarez — Security lead (SOC2, data residency questions)

2) Key decision criteria you called out
   - Latency SLA for inference (p50 / p95 targets)
   - Data isolation / VPC options and KMS support
   - Per-token cost sensitivity for production traffic
   - SOC2 + evidence for access controls and retention

3) Immediate asks from Novarisk
   - Security questionnaire (Tom) — we can provide a condensed evidence pack and SOC2 report
   - Procurement checklist and rough T&Cs so you can route internally
   - Pilot acceptance criteria (Marco) — define success metrics and timeline

4) Proposed Redwood commitments / next steps
   - I will assemble a one-page MAP (attached) with milestones, owners, and dates (pilot kickoff, security review, PO).
   - Ben will draft a short ROI one-pager for Elena highlighting cost vs. latency tradeoffs and estimated savings at 3/6/12 months.
   - Mina will own post-pilot enablement and success criteria for P1 integrations.

Ask: Marco — can you confirm the intended pilot start window (earliest available) and the legal contact at procurement? If procurement prefers, we can route an initial term sheet and a SOW template.

Attached: Novarisk_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP), redwood-security-summary.pdf (SOC2 excerpt + controls), novarisk_procurement_checklist.docx (example).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the consolidated MAP by Monday.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

From: Marco Diaz <m.diaz@novarisk.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novarisk.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novarisk.com>, procurement@novarisk.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 18:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Discovery action plan — roles, procurement milestones, and champion arming

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot window: we are targeting a 3-week pilot starting the week of Oct 11. That gives internal teams time to review security docs.
- Legal/procurement contact: procurement@novarisk.com is correct; Eva Linde in Legal will be the reviewer (eva.linde@novarisk.com).
- Success metrics: Marco -> latency under 250ms p95 for our key workflow; reduced inference cost per 1M tokens compared to current baseline.

Action items from Novarisk:
- Tom to collect and send an abbreviated security questionnaire (Tom will send by next Tue).
- Procurement to request a sample SOW and draft PO terms (procurement will outline timelines).

One favor — can Ben include a couple of concrete ROI scenarios in the one-pager (conservative, expected)? That helps Elena with the budget ask.

I’ll loop in Eva once we have the sample SOW.

—Marco
Principal ML Engineer | Novarisk

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Diaz <m.diaz@novarisk.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novarisk.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery action plan — roles, procurement milestones, and champion arming

Jordan / team — good call. I’ll take the ROI one-pager and include three scenarios: conservative, expected, upside. Plan:

- Draft ready Tue EOD (28 Sep) — includes cost per 1M tokens at current config, with recommendations on batching and quantization to hit target economics.
- Mina, can you add a short success-play for post-pilot adoption (what we ask the champion to do to drive internal adoption)? A 5-bullet talk track would be ideal.

Also, I’ll attach a lightly redlined SOW template and our standard commercial checklist to the MAP Jordan is consolidating. Jordan: when you send the consolidated MAP, please add a short paragraph that calls out fallback model options and the SLA we can promise during pilot.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Diaz <m.diaz@novarisk.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novarisk.com>, procurement@novarisk.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Eva Linde <eva.linde@novarisk.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery action plan — roles, procurement milestones, and champion arming

Hi all —

Attached is the consolidated MAP (Novarisk_MAP_v1.xlsx) with owners and proposed dates, plus the redwood-security-summary.pdf for Tom/Eva. Key highlights in the MAP:

- Pilot kickoff: Oct 11 (owner: Marco)
- Security review complete: Oct 4 (owner: Tom / Eva)
- PO expected: Oct 18 (owner: Procurement)
- Pilot success check-in: Oct 25 (owner: Jordan / Marco)

Ben’s ROI one-pager will hit Tue EOD. Ben — feel free to use the baseline telemetry we discussed (current p95 ~420ms; current cost $X per 1M tokens) — we’ll anonymize numbers before we share externally if needed.

Next asks (action owners):
- Tom / Eva: please confirm if the attached security summary and SOC2 excerpt meet your initial needs or if you prefer the full questionnaire.
- Procurement: confirm PO cadence and required PO language (payment terms / termination windows).
- Marco: final confirmation on pilot acceptance criteria (latency, accuracy threshold, integration checkpoints).

Thanks — I’ll follow up after Ben’s ROI doc lands and once procurement confirms PO timeline.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
